picked_rationale.C3: C3 is the most scientifically central claim: it tests bidirectional causal control via activation steering, which is the mechanistic crux of the four-part proposal (C1 extracts directions, C2 purifies them, C3 proves they causally control decisions, C4 proves selectivity). Without C3, C1 and C2 are observational-only. Additionally, C3's positive evidence is based on a supplementary L=16 run using raw directions — a deviation from the pre-registered protocol that makes robustness under a model swap the highest-value test. The orchestrator instruction also identifies C3 as the most consequential claim and the one with the most nuanced main-experiment result.
